maddeler.e:
أتلازم (form VI)
# أَتَلَازَمُ (ʔatalāzamu) /ʔa.ta.laː.za.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَلَازَمَ (talāzama)
# أَتَلَازَمَ (ʔatalāzama) /ʔa.ta.laː.za.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَلَازَمَ (talāzama)
# أَتَلَازَمْ (ʔatalāzam) /ʔa.ta.laː.zam/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَلَازَمَ (talāzama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
